## About
Best Tires & Auto Repair is a tire and repair shop on Oxnard St in North Hollywood. We handle the everyday work that keeps a car on the road: tires, alignments, oil changes, brakes, suspension, and heating and air conditioning.
We do the same kinds of services and repairs a dealership does, and every car that comes in for repair gets a free courtesy inspection. Drivers have given us a 4.3 rating across 44 Google reviews.
Give us a call before you come in and we will talk through the job and the price with you.

## Services
- Tire installation: New tires installed at a fair price.
- Wheel alignment: Both 4 wheel and 2 wheel alignments.
- TPMS service: Checks on your tire pressure monitoring system to help your tires last.
- Oil change: Engine oil changes as part of regular maintenance.
- Brake service: General brake work, including anti-lock (ABS) braking systems.
- Suspension service: Suspension work to keep your car riding and handling the way it should.
- Heating, air conditioning and electrical: Check engine lights, general electrical service, and heating and air conditioning.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get an estimate before you start?
A: Yes. Call us at (818) 308-8538 for a free estimate and we will go over the work and the price before anything gets done.

Q: Do you work on trucks and vans?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in a Ford Transit for an oil change.

Q: What kind of alignments do you do?
A: We do both 4 wheel and 2 wheel alignments.
